screening_decisions.reason: Observational comparative study, not an RCT. Compares outcomes between ERM and MH patients rather than comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap techniques.
Review article summarizing natural history and pathogenesis of idiopathic FTMH. Not an RCT.
Systematic review/meta-analysis comparing ILM peeling vs no peeling, not ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Wrong comparison.
RCT comparing vitrectomy surgery vs observation alone, not comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap techniques.
Population-based epidemiological survey on causes of visual impairment. Not related to macular hole surgery techniques.
Prospective randomized clinical trial comparing standard vitrectomy (with ILM peeling implied as standard care) vs inverted ILM flap technique for macular holes >400µm. Meets all criteria.
Retrospective consecutive noncomparative case series on reopening of macular holes. Not an RCT.
Compares complete ILM removal vs inverted ILM flap for myopic macular holes, but does not explicitly state randomization. Appears to be a comparative cohort study, not an RCT.
Theoretical paper proposing hydration theory for macular hole genesis. Not an RCT.
RCT comparing platelet-rich plasma vs inverted ILM flap, not ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Wrong comparison.
Epidemiological prevalence study of idiopathic macular hole in South India. Not an RCT.
Statistical methodology paper on detecting skewness. Completely unrelated to macular hole surgery.
Editorial/commentary discussing ILM peeling controversies. Not an RCT.
Classification system development paper for vitreomacular diseases. Not an RCT.
Prospective randomized interventional study comparing multilayered inverted ILM flap vs standard ILM peeling for large macular holes. Meets all criteria.
Observational study reviewing 158 eyes with evolving macular holes. Not an RCT.
Retrospective chart review on bilaterality of idiopathic macular holes. Not an RCT.
Compares inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling for large MHs, but does not explicitly state randomization. Appears to be a comparative cohort study (24 eyes total), not an RCT.
Compares ILM removal vs temporal inverted ILM flap, but does not explicitly state randomization. Appears to be a comparative cohort study (34 patients), not an RCT.
Prospective randomized control trial comparing inverted ILM flap vs ILM peeling for large FTMH (600-1500µm). Meets all criteria.
Methodological paper discussing statistical measures (H, R, I2) for assessing heterogeneity in meta-analyses. Not a clinical trial on macular hole surgery.
Review article covering classification, epidemiology, natural history, and general treatment outcomes of macular holes. Not an RCT comparing specific surgical techniques.
This is a meta-analysis of RCTs, not a primary randomized controlled trial. The protocol explicitly specifies inclusion of RCTs only.
Observational/pathogenesis study focusing on early biomicroscopic signs and vitreous shrinkage in macular holes. Not an interventional trial.

RCT comparing two variants of the inverted ILM flap technique (Cover vs Fill), not inverted ILM flap versus conventional ILM peeling. Additionally, the mean macular hole diameter was 397 µm, which is below the >400 µm threshold.
RCT comparing inverted ILM flap versus subretinal aspiration technique. Does not compare inverted ILM flap versus conventional ILM peeling as required by the protocol.
Narrative review discussing the rationale, evidence base, and surgical techniques for ILM peeling. Not an RCT.

Randomized controlled trial comparing ILM flat covering (inverted flap technique) versus ILM stripping (conventional peeling) for giant macular holes (>400 µm). Meets all population, intervention, comparison, and study design criteria.
RCT comparing extended versus standard ILM dissection methods. Does not evaluate inverted ILM flap versus conventional ILM peeling.
Epidemiological cross-sectional study on the prevalence and associations of epiretinal membranes in an older population. Unrelated to macular hole surgical interventions.
